# Zen Ramen & Sushi

> Japanese restaurant in Midtown Manhattan at 150 W 36th St (between 7th Avenue and Broadway): ramen and fresh sushi, daily happy hour 4–8 PM, weekday lunch specials, catering, takeout and delivery.

- Address: 150 W 36th St, New York, NY 10018 (Garment District; near Penn Station, Herald Square, Bryant Park, Koreatown and Madison Square Garden)
- Phone: (646) 870-7509
- Email: info@zenramensushiny.com
- Hours: Monday–Wednesday 11:30 AM–11:00 PM; Thursday–Friday 11:30 AM–12:00 AM; Saturday 12:00 PM–12:00 AM; Sunday 12:00 PM–11:00 PM
- Happy hour: every day, 4:00–8:00 PM
- Lunch specials: Monday–Friday, 11:30 AM–4:00 PM

## Menus

- [Menu](https://zenramensushiny.com/menu/): Dinner, lunch, happy hour and catering menus. Ramen, sushi, Japanese favorites and drinks, with cash and card prices.
- [Happy Hour](https://zenramensushiny.com/happy-hour/): Every day 4–8 PM: sushi rolls and appetizers at $6.49, plus sake, beer and cocktails.
- [Lunch Specials](https://zenramensushiny.com/lunch-specials/): Weekday sushi sets, bento boxes, rice dishes and lunch rolls from $3.50.
- [Events & Catering](https://zenramensushiny.com/events-catering/): Catering for corporate lunches, birthdays and celebrations in Midtown Manhattan.

## Visit

- [Location & Hours](https://zenramensushiny.com/location/): Hours, directions, and how to reach us from Penn Station.
- [Near Penn Station](https://zenramensushiny.com/near-penn-station/): Five minutes from Penn Station and Moynihan Train Hall.
- [Near Madison Square Garden](https://zenramensushiny.com/near-madison-square-garden/): A 6-minute walk from MSG, for before a game or concert.
- [About](https://zenramensushiny.com/about/): About the restaurant.
